scope: Inference-only fusion gate attribution on C25 step-250 checkpoint

gate_mechanism.parameter: fusion_modules[<name>].gate stores a raw logit; sigmoid applied at use
gate_mechanism.injection: fused features are ADDED to decoder hidden state h in ConditionalUNet.forward (h = h + injected_features[<name>]); the full fused tensor is injected, not only the gated residual

levels.low_res: 64 channels, injected after decoder up_blocks, before conv_out

gate_mechanism.independence: Two independent scalar gates; residuals computed by separate TemporalConv1DBlock modules
gate_mechanism.near_zero_bypass: If BOTH activated gates < 0.001, forward() uses _forward_frame_independent

logit_conversion.note: Gate values in the experiment table are ACTIVATED sigmoid values; raw logits computed as log(p/(1-p)) and written to fusion_modules.<name>.gate.data at inference only. Native logits restored after each configuration. Checkpoints never modified.

single_forward_isolation_test.conclusion: The bottleneck gate has NEGLIGIBLE effect on model output (~4e-5 max diff). Essentially all gate sensitivity resides in the low_res gate. Asymmetric pairs (C25_10_10 vs C25_25_10; C25_10_25 vs C25_0_25) produce near-identical videos, confirmed by generated-output diff ~1e-4.

runtime_residual_statistics.note: Gate override scales the gated delta linearly; residual magnitudes are gate-independent.
